text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It seems we're both running today, Fukukitaru. Um… Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And that, everyone, was my impression of the me from last year—a scaredy cat. Now, behold, the very picture of composure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Heaven never ceases to smile upon me! I'm sure you witnessed the full effects during the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You say you've seen the other side of speed, Suzuka? Hehehe! Wait till you get a load of me…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: With my almighty luck, I've breached the heavens to see the gods themselves!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today will be a battle for the books. Divine Luck versus the Speed Star. However…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm cool as a cucumber. With the heavens blessing my every step, winning this race will be a walk in the park.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka looks at me out of the corner of her eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's probably… not okay. Ever since the Kikuka Sho, she's been relying more and more on luck and divine protection, and…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has an especially strange look in her eyes today. I have a bad feeling about this.
